newsitem.title: USA: Zenith plans HDTV release by late 1998.
newsitem.headline: Zenith plans HDTV release by late 1998.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp said Friday that it will introduce the first generation digital high-definition television (HDTV) receivers by Christmas 1998.

It cited federal clearance granted Thursday for the switch to digital television from analog, President Peter Willmott said the digital HDTV sets Zenith initially expects to unveil are expected to be very large-screen projection models. Set-top boxes that will receive digital signals for display on conventional TV sets also are planned.
"The transition to digital HDTV will be more significant than the change from black-and-white to color TV," Willmott said in a statement.
